title: Hazing on the bus; Mackel looks after him
summary: Newcomers are ribbed over seats, but Mackel invited him to sit behind Hampton and taught him road savvy.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: When we got on the bus, the first thing that happen to me that threw me around, I didn't have a seat. Everybody got their own seat. And a newcomer, no matter who he is, he gets all...they rib him, right? He gets the business. So, same thing after I'm there, the next guy, I believe they ribbing whoever comes on.
What did they do to you?

'Oh, no, you can't sit in that seat because that seat is so-and-so's.' 'No, that's the wrong seat.' 'No, that's my seat, I'm just standing here for now.' I couldn't find a seat situation, right? So I had put my bass back there... 'No, don't, you can't put your bass there, man, because so-and-so'...

Now the bus is getting ready to pull out, headed up to Oregon, and William Mackel, he sat right behind Lionel Hampton on the bus. And this seat next to him was empty and he called me up. It's great now, because... I can relate to somebody that's low-keyed. I can turn it off and go the other way but I'm more comfortable where this guy is low-keyed, serious. I can turn it on and go the other way, but I have to go into a little acting thing, but I'm very comfortable with sitting next to Mackel. I knew I was home free. And we all... Even when he laughed, it wasn't... no commotion; just very reserved and I liked that.

Oh, he took care of me. He had me in shape in a week's time, I was in shape to cope with whatever.. He had me in shape. There should be people like Mackel with a school, a really school for experiencing the do's and don'ts and whatever about that.
What kinds of things did he tell you?
Like I'm saying, he would say... he had an answer for whatever I was asking.
You would ask about getting along on the road?

How to take care of yourself, even about the music, even about setting up on the bandstand, even about how you do your uniform, how you... He had it all. There's a whole thing about that. Now, if you really care, now but some people don't care. And that's OK. But if you, for the ones that really did care, you know, that's important.
